title: RSA preflight TOCTOU: getrandom success does not guarantee rsa crate will not panic
description: build_rsa_recipient() does a 256-byte getrandom preflight to surface RNG failures before calling rsa::encrypt (which uses UnwrapErr(SysRng) and panics on failure). The comment notes 'A narrow TOCTOU window between the preflight and the encrypt call remains.' The function is documented as 'may panic' in the public doc. This implicit invariant ('OS RNG will not fail between a successful preflight and the encrypt call') is load-bearing security assumption with no tests and no compile-time enforcement.
close_reason: TOCTOU is already documented in build_rsa_recipient. The narrow window is accepted and documented.
